purpose: Teach: いち早く/連ね/硬直/専任/クーポン/仕上がっ/大々的/各位

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合の動き、いち早く、把握しないとね、社員にも、情報収集、徹底させましょう、本当に、急務、本当に、必要よ、最近。
lines.en: We need to stay on top of the competition's moves. Let's make sure the team is thorough with intelligence gathering. It's really urgent right now.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Sharp emphasis on "stay on top." Professional cadence, no padding. Breath support steady. Lands the final clause with quiet urgency — this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業の関係者、名を、連ねた、リスト、できております、来週、共有いたしますね、本当に、皆、力を、合わせて。
lines.en: Yes. We've compiled a list of contacts from the new division. I'll share it next week. We really need everyone pulling together on this.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Light formality without stiffness. Steady pacing — building toward the collaborative note at the end. Small warmth on "everyone pulling together" — inclusion, not command.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 硬直した上下関係、変えていきましょうね、若手も、自由に、発言できる職場、目指していきましょう、本当に、楽しみよ。
lines.en: Let's break down these rigid hierarchies. We want to create a workplace where the younger staff feel free to speak up. I'm really looking forward to seeing that shift.
lines.style: Thoughtful opening — settling into the bigger idea. Warm and genuine on the vision. Slight lift on "looking forward" — optimism, not naïveté. Pace allows the idea to breathe.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。専任の広報担当、新人から、抜擢、検討中です、メディア対応、強化、必要ですね、本当に、急務なんです。
lines.en: Yes. We're considering promoting a new hire to dedicated PR. Strengthening media relations is something we really do need to prioritize.
lines.style: Clear, measured update. Professional without formality. Slight emphasis on "promoting" — confidence in the choice. Close on a note of quiet necessity — this is the right move.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様への、特別クーポン、新年度、用意していきましょうね、お客様、本当に、楽しみにされていますよ、いつも。
lines.en: Let's prepare special coupons for our regular customers for the new fiscal year. They're really looking forward to it — they always do.
lines.style: Gentle directive with warmth underneath. Affection for the customer relationship shows in tone. Unhurried pace. Small knowing smile on "they always do" — continuity, care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販促資料、ようやく、仕上がってまいりました、本当に、お時間、いただきましたよね、感謝しております、ご協力に。
lines.en: Yes. The promotional materials are finally ready. Thank you for taking the time on this — I really do appreciate the effort.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude in the voice. Ease and relief that the work is done. Warm on the thanks — this isn't perfunctory. Relaxed pace, slightly lighter than previous updates.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広告、もう少し、大々的に、打ち出していきましょうね、認知度、上げていきたいわ、業界、勝ち抜くわよ、本当に。
lines.en: Let's push the advertising harder — get it in front of more people. I want to raise our profile in the industry. We're going to win this.
lines.style: Stronger, more decisive energy. Forward momentum on "push harder." Confidence building through the line. Final clause lands with quiet conviction — not aggressive, just clear intention.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員各位、勤怠管理、新しい仕組み、ご案内、する予定です、皆様、ご協力、本当に、お願いいたします、必ず。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be announcing a new attendance-tracking system to everyone soon. I really need your cooperation on rolling this out smoothly — thank you.
lines.style: Professional, procedural opening. Slight formality appropriate to the administrative matter. Warmth returns on the request for cooperation — this is a partnership, not an imposition. Close with sincerity.
